title: Case 001: Was the one-off transfer sent?
initial_request: I can see a £420 debit for my one-off payment to Alder & Reed Workshop, but I need to know whether H&V sent it.
overview: Mara Ellison queried a one-off £420 transfer after seeing it debited from her account. H&V checked its own transfer journal and confirmed the transfer was marked as sent; there is no confirmation that the recipient bank received or credited it.

next_action.summary: Check the specific transfer's status in H&V's own journal.

outcome: H&V's journal recorded the transfer as sent, and the response was recorded in the secure portal. Receipt or credit by the recipient bank was not confirmed.

events.body: One-off transfer to Alder & Reed Workshop: debit shown in your account activity.
I arranged this £420 payment for a bookcase and can see the debit. Has H&V sent it? Please check the transfer status.
I am checking the journal entry for Mara Ellison's specific one-off £420 transfer to Alder & Reed Workshop. Please return the recorded transfer status.
Transfer status: SENT. This is H&V's outgoing-transfer record; recipient-bank receipt or credit is not confirmed.
Your secure portal status is “Sent”. H&V's journal records the transfer as sent, and our response has been recorded. This does not confirm receipt or credit by the recipient bank.
